definitions.explanation: A sudden, uncontrolled fall from a height, typically used for aircraft crashes or falls from elevated places. Implies a dramatic, often catastrophic descent.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}が{墜落|ついらく}した。
{墜落|ついらく}{事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}を{調査|ちょうさ}している。
examples.english: They are investigating the cause of the crash.

examples.japanese: ヘリコプターが{山中|さんちゅう}に{墜落|ついらく}し、{乗員|じょういん}{全員|ぜんいん}が{救助|きゅうじょ}された。
examples.english: A helicopter crashed in the mountains, and all crew members were rescued.

notes: Used with する to form the verb {墜落|ついらく}する (to crash, to plunge). Almost exclusively used for falls from significant heights, especially aircraft. Common collocations: {墜落|ついらく}{事故|じこ} (crash accident), {墜落|ついらく}{現場|げんば} (crash site), {墜落|ついらく}{防止|ぼうし} (fall prevention — in construction safety). Related: {落下|らっか} (falling — more general, includes dropping objects), {転落|てんらく} (fall — typically from an edge or ledge, e.g., a cliff or platform).
